rule: Proof paths use pinned native sources, explicit constructions and native deductions. Imported classical, admitted, open and comparison-only premises are excluded. A native propagation defect and channel ratio do not select a physical mass or charge interpretation.

claims.title: Flat returning records do not change the declared source response
claims.scope_boundary: Reciprocal edge records and homogeneous commuting direction records, one-address product preparation. Local source readouts and the specified retained-arrival system cross response are unchanged. Full record histories are not erased; arbitrary multi-address equivalence is not asserted.

claims.scope_boundary: Native two-event commutator-square readout for source e0 and pairing-preserving record arrows. A fixed preparation requires its entire forward word orbit for all-order equivalence; a single zero initial test is insufficient.

claims.title: One reused H/K record changes path signs without a free record state
claims.scope_boundary: Reused anticommuting native H/K direction record. Endpoint operator factorization and signed source stencil; no dephasing law or adjustable record-preparation coupling.

claims.title: Anticommuting memory generates an exact native propagation gap
claims.scope_boundary: Lower bound for the squared native (V^2-I) defect divided by finite source norm, with sharp infimum one and supremum three. No Hamiltonian, physical energy, particle mass or Yang-Mills mass-gap identification.

claims.title: Signed first excursions determine the new return grammar
claims.scope_boundary: New signed first-return grammar of this H/K-record transport, derived by finite enclosure/reflection counts. R24 return splitting is reused; its numerical eta is not substituted for the new return mass.

claims.title: The return series has native completion bounds and a unitary coherent value
claims.scope_boundary: All-depth coefficient and completion bounds on native cut scalars, with already-derived iota in the tail argument. Retained-arrival p is distinct from the coherently folded unitary first-return map. Coherent folding is not claimed to be an isometric erasure of flags.

claims.title: Return parity fixes one feedback coefficient exactly
claims.scope_boundary: Arrival-retained source-controlled feedback with a reused record. Return parity remains until summation; source/record relative operator factors D_N tensor I, including entangled source/record input. Arrival flags remain a declared construction.

claims.title: Completed feedback yields a fixed channel ratio and certified limits
claims.scope_boundary: Completed response and exact source-channel ratio three inside the stated interface. Tail and terminal bounds follow from native pairing/counts; no physical charge or alpha identification. Canonical decimal intervals are outward rational enclosures, not fitted parameters.

claims.title: Copying source letters has its own derived normalization constraint
claims.scope_boundary: Literal source-letter copy, distinct from direction control. Normalization forces zero cut-real flag overlap. Orthogonality follows only in the real flag sector; native iota-valued flags admit another repair, so no unique physical record is selected.
